d: Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates a portfolio of 31 exceptional properties across 13 countries in the Middle East, Europe, Asia, and Africa. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and since then the brand has become known for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels, and exclusive branded residences. Jumeirah is synonymous with Arabian luxury hospitality and the ability to craft distinctive, purposeful experiences for the world’s most discerning travellers.

Located on the pristine beaches of Bahrain’s West Coast, the resort features stunning ocean views, verdant greenery, and meandering waterways with modern, spacious rooms and suites as well as an exclusive Gulf Summer House, located directly on the beach. Guests can enjoy a variety of water sports activities, the resort’s five pools, and book treatments at Jumeirah’s signature Talise Spa.

r: An exciting opportunity has arisen for Intern – Marketing to join Jumeirah Gulf of Bahrain.
The Main Duties And Responsibilities Of This Role Include

Digital Content Creation: Take an active role in the audit, creation, and enhancement of digital content across various owned channels. Participate in content ideation, creation, and optimization, ensuring brand consistency, relevance, and engagement across different digital platforms.

Data-Driven Reporting: Utilize analytical skills to track, analyze, and interpret Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for both corporate and hotel-specific campaigns. Assist in generating insightful reports that provide stakeholders with valuable insights, contributing to data-informed decision-making.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate seamlessly with diverse cross-functional teams, including sales, public relations, hotel marketing, and revenue departments. Contribute your unique perspective and skills to interdisciplinary projects, fostering a holistic understanding of marketing operations.

Administrative Support: Play an integral role in the administrative aspects of the CRM department. Prepare compelling presentations, insightful reports, and accurate meeting minutes, showcasing your attention to detail and organizational skills.
